title: “Unguzhol – zaman talaba”: BMUda uluttuk ideany chagyldyrgan kitep zharyk kordu

blocks.text: 2025-zhyldyn 19-June academician K.Karasaev atyndagy Bishkek mamlekettik universityinde “Uluttuk dem – duinoluk biyiktik” unguzholunun alkagynda “Unguzhol – zaman talaby” attuu ilimiy-methodikalyk kiteptin bet achar azemi bolup өттү. Bul emgek universitytin okumushtuulary tarabynan dayardalyp, Zharlykta belgilengen bagyttardy ishke ashyruuga bagyttalgan.

Ish-charaga mamlekettik katchy Marat Imankulov, Presidential administration okulu, tarykh ilimderinin doctor Oktyabr Kapalbaev, Uluttuk Ilimder Akademiasynin vice president, academician Cholponkul Arabaev, belgiluu okumushtuular – professor Sulaiman Kaiypov, Kyyas Moldokasimov, oshondoy ele universitytin professorduk-okutuuchuluk kurama zhan studentter katyshty.

Kitepte “Uluttuk dem – duynoluk biyiktik” unguzholunda karalgan mamlekettik til, uluttuk tarykh, kyrgyz philosophy, ethnopedagogy zhana ecology syyaktuu negizgi tort bagyt ilimiy negizde taldanyp berylet. Authorlordun aitymynda, globaldashuu shartynda uluttuk өzgөchөlүktөrүbүzdu — tilibizdi, madaniyatybyzdy, kaada-salttarybyzdy saktoo zhana onukturүu koom aldyndagy maaniluu mildet. Bul kitep dal ushul maksatta zhazylyp, uluttuk baaluuluktarybyzdy duinoluk dengeelde taanytuuga salym koshot.
